title: Battle of Martorell (1641)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Martorell (1641)", at revision 1370269122, opens: "The Battle of Martorell is one of the episodes of the Reapers' War in Catalonia that took place from 20 to 23 January 1641 and ended in a victory for the Spanish troops." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q2889282, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1641 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane kept by A15(6): it was derived from spain-q29, the country this event was placed at, and that place is refused while the lane it gave is right.
